## Rights of Learners

As a student in this class, you have the right...

::: {.callout}
[to be confused.]{style="color:red"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[to say what makes sense to you.]{style="color:blue"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[to make mistakes.]{style="color:green"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[to share unfinished thinking and not be judged.]{style="color:purple"}
:::

::: {.callout}
[to revise your thinking.]{style="color:orange"}
:::
